decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a low-cost extension of the established map.apps platform, but with no website visibility since 2018 it may be absorbed or retired, so it stays at moderate risk.

VueTOC was a 2018 component whose visibility has since faded, and the mobile UI functionality is likely being folded into newer frameworks, so problemistic search points to redirecting its resources to the core platform.
The software platform is the flagship product line defining the firm's strategic direction, and the firm will keep investing in it while industry growth provides the slack to do so.
Mobile field data capture meets core customer needs in utilities and the public sector, so despite lower visibility it plausibly meets aspirations and stays.

The search extension is cheap to maintain within the web map apps, but after the withdrawal of the similar search plugin B it carries elevated risk of consolidation, though slack still supports keeping it.
